remarks: This 1 bed/1 bath seasonal cabin is located on 3.3 acres in Birdsall NY. Large circular driveway leads to a serene cabin surrounded by trees. Enjoy the view from the deck. There is also a newer large shed for extra storage! Cabin has a dug well, both wood stove and propane heater, electric, no septic. Cabin has been re-leveled with pressure treated timber. Metal roof 8 years old, hot water tank 2015, well pump 2015. Plenty of extra sleeping space in the main living area. Property being sold "as-is" with all contents included. Located near state land, Swain Ski Resort, Birdsall Inn, the Maple Tree Inn, Stonybrook State Park. Perfect for the avid hunter or a great getaway.
